statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail is 4, low, because CME equity index futures have been halted since Friday at 21:00Z and sixteen of the twenty-four hours published here contain no tradable interval at all; only the eight slots from the scheduled 22:00Z Sunday reopen onward are tradable, and they carry conditional Tail readings of 12, 13, 12, 11, 10, 10, 10 and 10 that stay far below the block threshold. Stress is 34, moderate: the 50% US tariff on about $20 billion of Canadian goods is in force after trade talks collapsed, Canada has dated a dollar-for-dollar match to 8 September, a Monday US press conference on isolating Iran's economy is scheduled, the thirty-year Treasury yield sits at 5.23% on the latest H.15 column and was reported near 5.27% into Friday's close, and crude has gained about 5% for a second consecutive week, none of it priced until the venue reopens. Confidence is 86, high: index level, yields, volatility, energy and the seven-day calendar were each re-verified against primary sources this hour, and the only missing input is live price-path evidence, which no source can supply while the market is shut.
recommendation: The last observed session remains consistent with functioning mean reversion rather than a one-way path: cash NDX opened at 29,359.60, traded down to 29,142.44, recovered to 29,405.12 and closed at 29,308.86, up 0.33% on the day and below its own open, ending a five-day losing streak, while the VIX settled at 14.89 near the low of a 14.77-15.95 range. Both session extremes were retraced and neither produced repeated extension after a failed pullback, so no Tail amplifier carries over from observed structure. Friday internals were split rather than aligned, with application and infrastructure software up about 1.2% against semiconductors down 0.31%, megacap dispersion was wide at roughly 1.8 percentage points, and cross-asset direction was mixed, with gold higher, energy higher and Treasury futures lower. Mapped policy state remains EA_ON across the whole horizon. The narrow evidence-based danger window covers 22:00Z to 02:00Z, the reopen gap and the thin hours before Asian cash liquidity is fully engaged, and it rests on a conditional scenario rather than on observed structure.
headline: Closed-venue assessment with eight reopen hours inside the horizon: Tail holds the floor of 4 through sixteen shut hours, then carries conditional readings of 12, 13, 12, 11, 10, 10, 10 and 10 from the 22:00Z Sunday reopen, while live US tariffs on Canadian goods, a scheduled Monday Iran economic-isolation announcement, a post-2007 long end and a second week of energy gains stay unpriced.
body: CME Globex equity index futures stopped trading for the week on Friday at 21:00Z and are scheduled to reopen on Sunday at 22:00Z. The twenty-four slots published here run from 2026-08-23T06:00:00Z to 2026-08-24T05:00:00Z, so the reopen slot and the first seven hours after it sit inside the horizon. Cash NDX settled at 29,308.86 on Friday, up 0.33% from a 29,213.17 prior close, after opening at 29,359.60 and printing a 29,142.44 low and a 29,405.12 high; both extremes were retraced inside the session, the close finished below the open, and the day ended a five-day losing streak even as the Nasdaq Composite lost about 2% on the week in a Treasury-led selloff. The VIX settled at 14.89, down 6.0%, near the low of a 14.77-15.95 range. On policy, the 50% US tariff on roughly $20 billion of Canadian goods took effect after Friday midnight once talks collapsed, and Prime Minister Carney has said Canada will match it dollar for dollar from 8 September across steel, dairy, appliances, agricultural equipment, pulp and paper and electronics. The Treasury Secretary is scheduled to detail plans to isolate Iran's economy at a Monday press conference, with Hormuz transits reported near 20% of the pre-war average and WTI near $87 after a second consecutive weekly gain of about 5%. The 20 August H.15 column shows 4.19% two-year, 4.69% ten-year and 5.23% thirty-year, with the long end reported near 5.27% into Friday's close. None of that can be expressed in the index until the venue reopens, which is why current Tail stays at its closed-venue floor of 4 while Stress carries the unpriced stack at 34 and builds toward the reopen. The conditional readings after 22:00Z describe gap and thin-liquidity scenarios only; no reopen structure has been observed, and the first genuinely tradable evidence will arrive in the hour after the reopen.

lookbackSummary: Claude coverage over the past 24 hours is nearly complete: 22 hourly assessments are available, while the 06:00Z and 21:00Z clock-hours on 22 August have no published assessment and are marked unavailable. Across every available hour Tail held 4 and the mapped policy state stayed EA_ON, so no hour approached the block threshold and the dominant mode remained normal throughout. Stress traced a shallow arc across the shut weekend: 38 at the start of the window, a build to 42 through Saturday afternoon as the Canadian response was dated and the Iran announcement was scheduled, then a steady easing back to 35 as the same static stack aged without new escalation. Confidence held in a narrow 86 to 88 band for the whole window, reflecting evidence that is complete for a closed market and refreshed each hour against primary sources. No hour in the lookback contained a tradable Nasdaq-100 interval, so none of these readings rests on observed price-path structure.
outlookSummary: The current hour carries Tail at 4 because CME equity index futures are confirmed halted and no Nasdaq-100 price path can develop inside this slot. The following fifteen slots describe the same closed market, so Tail holds 4 and the mapped policy state stays EA_ON throughout them, while Stress holds 34 through the quiet European hours and then rebuilds to 47 by the last shut hour as the reopen approaches with the information set unchanged. The final eight slots are tradable: the 22:00Z scheduled reopen carries a conditional Tail of 12, the first full hour after it the horizon peak of 13, the hour coinciding with the Monday Tokyo cash open a conditional 12, and the last five slots 11, 10, 10, 10 and 10 as Hong Kong and mainland liquidity join. All of those readings rest on gap and thin-liquidity scenarios rather than on observed structure, and all remain green. The invalidation to watch in the first tradable hours is a reopen gap that is defended rather than retraced, with repeated extension after failed pullbacks; that structure would raise Tail at the next hourly assessment, and its absence would confirm the published path.
